nameForms.name: King of Aragon
nameForms.note: The Aragonese royal line begins with Ramiro I, illegitimate son of Sancho III of Pamplona, and descends through Petronilla to the dynastic union with the House of Barcelona.
nameForms.noteCn: 阿拉贡王位链始于桑乔三世的非婚生子拉米罗一世，经佩特罗妮拉与巴塞罗那家族达成王朝联合。

holders.note: Illegitimate son of Sancho III of Pamplona; first King of Aragon.
holders.noteCn: 桑乔三世的非婚生子；阿拉贡首位国王。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Ramiro I; also King of Pamplona from 1076.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父拉米罗一世；1076 年起兼潘普洛纳国王。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Sancho Ramírez; died without surviving issue.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父桑乔·拉米雷斯；无存活子嗣而终。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother Peter I; died without legitimate issue.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄佩德罗一世；无合法子嗣而终。

holders.note: Alfonso I died without legitimate issue, so his brother Ramiro, a monk, was elected king; he abdicated in 1137.
holders.noteCn: 阿方索一世无合法子嗣而终，其兄、身为修士的拉米罗被推举为王；后于 1137 年退位。

holders.note: Ramiro II abdicated in her favor; she ruled as queen in her own right.
holders.noteCn: 拉米罗二世让位；她以自身权利成为在位女王。

holders.note: Count of Barcelona and Prince of Aragon through his marriage to Petronilla; the union joined Aragon and Barcelona, but he never bore the title King of Aragon.
holders.noteCn: 巴塞罗那伯爵，因与佩特罗妮拉的婚姻而称阿拉贡亲王并共同治理；婚姻促成两地王朝联合但并未立刻合并，且他从未称阿拉贡国王。
